questions.question: What motivated you to go on exchange? (pick the most important one) *
questions.answer: Explore new cultures

questions.question: Which aspects were crucial to choosing your study destination? *
questions.answer: Siden jeg studerer Koreastudier, var Korea som destination det mest oplagte valg.

questions.question: How would you rate your overall study abroad experience? *
Additional comments:
How easy was it to find the information you needed to know upon arrival? *
questions.answer: Det var ret nemt. Al information blev uploaded på en app kaldet BAND. Dog var den udleverede adresse til kollegiet ikke helt rigtig, så vores taxachauffør blev forvirret men fandt det dog til sidst.

questions.question: What assistance, if any, did you receive when you arrived at your study destination? *
questions.answer: Jeg kan ikke helt huske det præcist. Men dagen efter check-in på kollegiet sad to af de internationale repræsentanter fra universitet i lobbyen. Derudover havde vi altid mulighed for at kontakte vores kontaktperson fra universitet. Vi havde også fået kontakt til vores buddy allerede hjemmefra.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the orientation and assistance available to students at your host institution upon arrival? *
Additional comments
How did you find housing? *
questions.answer: I found housing through my host institution

questions.question: Did you live on campus or off campus? *
questions.answer: On campus

questions.question: What options were available for on campus housing? *
questions.answer: Kollegie. Det lå lidt uden for campus, men det tager kun ca. 10-15 min at gå til campus.

questions.question: What options were available for meal plans or cooking facilities? *
questions.answer:
- Én mikroovn, som tre etager deltes om
- Vanddispenser på hver etage
- Hverken køkken eller køleskab til rådighed

questions.question: What should future exchange students know about on campus housing? *
questions.answer:
- Der er kun én mikroovn, og folk har svært ved at gøre rent efter sig. 
- Der er ikke et køleskab. Vi måtte vente på at vejret blev koldt nok, så vi kunne sætte mad ud på den lukkede altan. Dog har hvert værelse en lukket altan, hvor man har mulighed for at hænge sit vasketøj. 
- Værelserne var ikke særlig rengjorte, da vi kom.
- Trods dette var det billigt at bo der.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the housing available to students? *
Additional comments:
How easy did you find the registration process at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer:
Jeg husker det som om, at vi fik et dokument, der ret udførligt beskrev, hvordan vi skulle registrere os kurser/fag. Men vi blev ikke gjort opmærksom på, at vi i første registrerings-runde kun kunne tilmelde os nogle fag. Derfor nåede vi at blive temmelig urolige. Senere fik vi en besked hvor der stod, at de andre fag kunne tilmeldes i næste runde. 

Registreringsprocessen foregik om natten (dansk tid). Det kører efter 'først til mølle'-princippet.

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: Vi kunne kontakte vores buddy.

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: Jeg blev tilmeldt alle de fag, jeg ønskede.

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer:
Hav navnene på fagene klar, så de bare kan kopieres ind. 
Log ind på hjemmesiden inden registreringsprocessen går i gang for at få et overblik over hjemmesiden (den er på koreansk)

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the academic programme at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Were you a BA or MA student at UCPH when you were on exchange? *
questions.answer: BA

questions.question: Did you take BA or MA courses at your host university? *
questions.answer: BA

questions.question: Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer: Der var meget niveauforskel på de forskellige fag.

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: Nærmest ingen lektier i Korea.

questions.question: How long were you on exchange? *
questions.answer: 1 semester

questions.question: Please list the courses you were enrolled in during your first semester. *
questions.answer:
Sports and Health (Pilates)
Korean Language and Culture for Foreginers
Volunteering Program
Philosophy in the Age of A.I. 
Case Study of Corporate Management in Korea and Overseas

questions.question: What specific courses would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer:
Volunteering Program
Sports and Health (Pilates)
Korean Language and Culture for Foreginers
Philosophy in the Age of A.I.

questions.question: Insurance DKK *
Housing DKK per month *
Books DKK per month *
Local transportation DKK per month *
Food DKK per month *
Personal spending DKK per month *
Communication (phone, internet, etc.) DKK per month *
Other fees DKK per month *
What unexpected costs did you encounter? *
questions.answer:
Jeg forstuvede min fod, så jeg måtte til lægen og lægge ud for betaling der (betalt af forsikring).

Derudover var mad budgettet dyrere end forventet, ikke pga. priserne på mad men fordi vi ikke havde et køleskab eller køkken til rådighed, så vi måtte købe meget mad udefra.

questions.question: What items were more or less expensive than you expected? *
questions.answer: Transport til Seoul. Tager man metroen i stedet for toget, kan man komme ind til Seoul for under 4000won.

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the non-academic opportunities (clubs, sports, etc.) at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
What kinds of cultural, athletic and social activities were available for students at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Der var mulighed for at blive optaget i en af uni-klubberne. Derudover arrangerede OIA (office of international affairs) forskellige ture og arrangementer for de udvekslingsstuderende.

questions.question: Which non -academic activities would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: Turen til Legoland. Legoland i sig selv var lidt kedelig, men det var rigtig hyggeligt at gå rundt sammen.

questions.question: What do you recommend other visiting students see or do on their weekends or holidays? *
questions.answer: Naturen i og omkring Chuncheon, ture til Seoul eller andre byer mm.

questions.question: How easy was it to adjust to the local culture of your exchange site? *
questions.answer: Folk i byen var utrolig venlige, så det var ikke så svært.

questions.question: Do you have any tips for socializing with local students?
questions.answer:
Enten vær så ekstrovert og venlig som muligt og selv tage kontakt, eller vent på at de ekstroverte lokale tager kontakt til dig. 
Evt. melde sig ind i en klub.

questions.question: What, if any, cultural differences did you find particularly challenging? *
questions.answer: At undervisere ud i klassen nogle gange spurgte andre ind til, hvorfor en person ikke var dukket op, eller spurgte personen direkte gangen efter. Jeg er nok vant til, at det er et privat anliggende, om man kommer til undervisning eller ej.

questions.question: What parts of the culture did you most appreciate? *
questions.answer: Gæstfrihed.

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer: 1. Det er rart at have mindst én anden med, som man kender. Da nogle fag tages på koreansk, er der information, der kun bliver givet på koreansk, så det kan være rart med en sparringspartner.

questions.question: Is there any other information that you think might prove useful to future exchange students attending your host institution? *
questions.answer: Om sommeren er der rigtig mange edderkopper, så det er måske lidt af en udfordring, hvis man lider af araknofobi.

questions.question: What was the most rewarding part of your exchange experience? *
questions.answer: Muligheden for frivilligt arbejde. Det var en helt og aldeles skøn oplevelse at få lov til at være en del af lokalsamfundet. Vi arbejdede som hjælpelærere, hvor vi underviste yngre skolebørn i Engelsk, og det var virkelig hyggeligt at interagere med børnene. Kollegaerne på stedet var også rigtig imødekommende, og vi blev inviteret på middag på vores sidste arbejdsdag.

questions.question: What was the greatest challenge during the exchange? *
questions.answer: Hjemve.

questions.question: Any other comments?
Do you agree to share your travel report with other fellow students? *
questions.answer: Yes
